name: com.tencent.tcr.ar.activity.ConnectHuaweiAppMarketActivity
description: When Tencent TCR's AR view cannot use Huawei AR Engine and the device does not support ARCore, this Activity asks whether to open Huawei AppGallery to install the AR service.
disableEffect: Without this Activity, the AR view cannot show its install prompt on devices that need Huawei's AR service, so that AR session may not start.
